_comment: Real project history from field work. 'image' paths intentionally point at the existing /portfolio image assets so photos aren't duplicated in the repo.

items.title: First Heavy Drone
items.summary: X8-configuration heavy drone (2x6S LiPo, 8x U12 motors, 32" props) built on the open-source Pixhawk/ArduPilot stack to validate PID, adaptive-PID and sliding-mode control algorithms with researchers at GIST and KAIST.

items.title: Agri Drone
items.summary: Precision pesticide-spraying drone carrying 20L payload, flying as low as 5m with 5-8cm accuracy. Combined RTK GPS, WMS mapping and multispectral NDVI imagery to auto-adapt spray density and flight height.

items.title: Design, Fly, Crash, Learn Cycle
items.summary: Rapid iteration workflow pairing Matlab-Simulink and open-source ROS/Gazebo/RViz simulation with real field testing to de-risk high-budget UAS development.

items.title: Holographic 3D Projection on Sky
items.summary: Government-funded R&D project flying coordinated drones carrying a screen and laser projector to perform 3D holographic projection at 30m altitude.

items.title: Prototype-level PCBs
items.summary: Designed and prototyped Arduino/Raspberry Pi shields for motor, I2C, SPI and CAN drivers, RGB indicators and keypad/display holders using Eagle, Proteus and Cadence EDA tooling.

items.title: VTOL for Sea Ports
items.summary: Autonomous fixed-wing/VTOL aircraft transferring ship-clearance documents between vessels and port offices for DP World, Dubai, with a custom parabolic antenna tracker for 7-15km telemetry range.

items.title: WeGo
items.summary: Humanoid-type indoor service rover using a 16-channel LiDAR for localisation, used to greet guests, check appointments and direct visitors at reception.

items.title: Mega VTOL
items.summary: Prototype heavy-lift VTOL UAV concept for firefighting support and emergency medical transport, including custom battery pack design and bespoke motor specification.

items.title: Converging Double-Cabin Truck
items.summary: Autonomous heavy-vehicle retrofit combining Radar, LiDAR, ultrasonics, camera, GPS and IMU sensing with SLAM, built on the open-source Autoware stack.
